_comment: multiple-version line, MC 1.19.2 forge. Runs the standalone in-client UI test harness (uitest/mv-1.19.2-forge, an independent Gradle build in this repository on ModDevGradle legacyforge) through the three-stage pipeline config->build->test; the two production (SRG-named) jars ride MDG's remapping modRuntimeOnly configuration out of a content-addressed flatDir repository inside the build. The old skip named two gaps, and the harness closes both: it creates the level itself (1.19.2's WorldOpenFlows.createFreshLevel, 4-argument generation — no quick-play needed, which was the written-down reason a 1.19.2 row could never reach a level), and its own build is the launch path (the checkout's JPMS split package never existed here — JECh rides as one jar). The JEI 11.x storage marker still arrives the way it always did, at level load. Harness-row shape, as the 1.21.1 rows carry it: no ready_when, no world, no gradle block, and every artifact via=dev-classpath (the standalone build loads everything itself; a jt-staged copy would double-load).
name: mv-1.19.2-forge
